topic: credit and financial statement analysis of small and mid-size US public companies from their SEC filings (prefer filings from 2025-2026, which models are unlikely to have memorized)
skill: Given excerpts of a company's 10-Q or 10-K (financial statements, MD&A, liquidity section), act as a credit analyst: compute the metrics the statements imply, and forecast figures (revenue, cash, net loss, shares outstanding) that the company's NEXT periodic filing reports
